challenged_premise: Three eigenvalues of absolute value at least one force constant-size curvature on some dimension-independent set of original independent coordinates, in particular a uniformly definite physical 2x2 principal block.
correction: False. For n=2^k, A=U diag(1,1,-1) U^T with U the first three normalized Sylvester-Hadamard columns has spectrum (+1,+1,-1,0,...) while every physical m-coordinate compression satisfies ||A_SS||op<=3m/n and every physical 2x2 principal determinant is nonpositive.
repair: Use the distributed determinant-mass identity for a same-sign spectral pair: det(P_ij)=lambda_1 lambda_2 det(R_ij)^2 and sum_{i<j}det(P_ij)=lambda_1 lambda_2. Any successful curved-fiber argument must aggregate these weights without selecting one large physical block and without discarding product structure.
full_target_effect: Does not refute the quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture; refutes only a proposed finite-coordinate localization step.
